# smallest-complete-slice

Prefer one complete path with real failure states over a wide partial surface.

**When:** Planning delivery order or resisting speculative infrastructure.

**Why:** Partial platforms hide whether the product works. Vertical proof teaches faster.

**Do not:** Build shared frameworks for a single unproven journey.

Cite this principle by id when it changed a decision. Keep the citation specific.
